name: v0.3.39 — flat receipt hero + item-detail redesign + mascot animations + P0 fixes
releaseNotes:
• Receipt detail screen: flat white hero (no more heavy emerald gradient + wave), dark ink on white, action row pinned to top. Matches the rest of the app canvas.
• Item detail screen: brand-new Fetch-style design with pastel-gradient hero, big title, Buy-N badge, lifetime-spend chip, cadence pill row, Where-You've-Bought-It, Recent Receipts (tappable to receipt detail). Same on web.
• Mascot animations on key events: bounce on receipt save, wiggle on smashlist mark-done, celebrate (with 12-particle confetti!) on Worth-It rate + referral apply + 7-day Smash-days milestones.
• Pre-launch hardening: smashDays UTC/local drift fixed (web now matches mobile day boundary), referral smash_days_bonus is now actually added to your dashboard streak, /admin/cost cron auth tightened to CRON_SECRET (no more header-only bypass).
• Mobile item-detail query now filters user_id server-side instead of client-side — less bandwidth, defense-in-depth on top of RLS.
• Affiliate-tagging scaffold landed (web/src/lib/affiliate.js) for Amazon Associates + Skimlinks. Code is ready; just needs you to drop your tracking ID into NEXT_PUBLIC_AMAZON_ASSOC_TAG to start earning.
